name: Pendon injection
comment: Adds the Pendon rules to the built-in Markdown grammar, so .md files highlight Pendon syntax. All rules live in pendon.tmLanguage.json; keep this file tiny. The .mdp grammar already contains them, so it is excluded: injecting into a grammar that includes the same rules recurses.
injectionSelector: L:text.html.markdown - (comment, string, meta.embedded, markup.raw, markup.fenced_code.block, text.html.markdown.pendon)
